metaTitle: Custom Full Color T Shirts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom full color t shirts with vivid, all-over prints. Bulk pricing for events, teams & giveaways. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Full color decoration on t shirts opens up design possibilities that standard one- or two-color screen printing cannot match. Whether you need photographic detail, gradient blends, or complex logos across the entire shirt, full color sublimation or direct-to-garment printing delivers crisp, vibrant results on fabrics like the Gildan Softstyle or Hanes Nano-T. This option works well for event staff uniforms, trade show giveaways, or promotional apparel where brand imagery must pop. Bulk orders keep per-unit costs manageable, and we offer a range of unisex, ladies, and youth styles to fit your team.
